body_lead: Bhopal: The Madhya Pradesh cabinet on Tuesday approved a five-year Rs 734-crore push for science and technology, as chief minister Mohan Yadav said the state should take a leading role in implementing the Prime Ministerâs AI skilling and youth talent development initiatives announced on Independence Day. The cabinet meeting was chaired by CM Yadav. Briefing reporters after the meeting, minister Rakesh Singh said the Rs 734-crore allocation would support science and technology schemes over the five-year period from April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2031.
